name: Rachel no Omoide
source:
The protagonist is Kaori Kashima, a second-year high school student.

She and her best friend Rachel are on their way home when suddenly, a person in a black hood appears and fatally stabs Rachel.

Somehow, Kaori acquires a time machine and manages to go back in time.

But she soon realizes something's different here—it's a parallel world.

Rachel is alive and well, but Kaori feels she must return to the original timeline.

Where and when did this parallel world split off?

Searching her memories for answers, she attempts time travel again at the moment of divergence, but—

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031930/Memories_of_Rachel/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
本作主角是高中二年级女生鹿岛香织。

放学回家途中，她与挚友蕾切尔并肩同行，谁知一名身披黑色连帽衫的神秘人突然现身，用刀刺中蕾切尔致其身亡。

阴差阳错之下，香织获得了一台时间机器，成功回到了过去。

然而她很快察觉到这里有哪里不太对劲——这是一个平行世界。

眼前的蕾切尔依然健康地活着，可香织心底却觉得自己必须回到原本的世界线。

这个平行世界究竟是在何时、何地发生了分歧？

在记忆深处搜寻着线索的香织，赶在世界线分歧的那一瞬间再次尝试时空穿越，然而——

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031930/Memories_of_Rachel/]Steam[/url]]
